tiers.label: one line
tiers.note: One line names the subject and nothing else: the model picks its own wide, distant framing.

tiers.label: setting and mood
tiers.note: Setting and mood fill the street with neon and a stray figure the prompt never asked for.

tiers.label: four-part grammar

tiers.label: + tag vocabulary + negative prompt

tiers.label: + shot size, camera angle, colour script
tiers.note: Rule-of-thirds headroom and a named colour script finish the keyframe this course reuses from here on.
